decisions.quote: The purpose of this research was to conduct a practice-based replication of Academic and Behavior Combined Support (ABC Support), a previously developed and experimentally evaluated supplemental intervention that merges a combined focus on reading fluency and academic engagement.
decisions.location: Current primary Abstract; complete deposited references and independently verified original reports0121
decisions.reason: The current4-student Grade2practice-based replication describes an earlier experimentally evaluated ABC Support intervention and repeats reading-fluency/engagement/disruption outcomes. Complete original-source inspection establishes the2021JSP article at1563as the empirical evaluation, with six teacher-student dyads, randomized multiple baseline and reported outcome changes. The second ABC Support reference,2022Intervention in School and Clinic, is complete practitioner implementation guidance with10elements/15steps and no empirical study sample/design/outcome analysis. Step2 therefore uniquely selects the2021evaluation by description. No same-dataset equivalence is inferred. The raw expert reason incorrectly attributes a five-author guidance citation including Schienebeck; the actual inspected online-first guidance author block is Gettinger/Kratochwill/Foy/Eubanks. That author-list claim is not adopted. The selected2021five-author empirical citation is independently supported. No source-body completeness or analytic equivalence is inferred for the unavailable2024body.

raw_expert_opinion.quote: The purpose of this research was to conduct a practice-based replication of Academic and Behavior Combined Support (ABC Support), a previously developed and experimentally evaluated supplemental intervention that merges a combined focus on reading fluency and academic engagement.
raw_expert_opinion.reason: The source text available to the blind coder is an abstract reporting a single-case practice-based replication of the previously developed and experimentally evaluated Academic and Behavior Combined Support (ABC Support) intervention by the same author team (Gettinger, Kratochwill, Levin, Eubanks, & Foy). Because only the abstract was available, the blind coder left the bibliographic fields empty. Shipped row input_row_index 1563 (Gettinger, Kratochwill, Eubanks, Foy, & Levin, 2021, 'Academic and Behavior Combined Support: Evaluation of an integrated supplemental intervention for early elementary students', Journal of School Psychology, doi: 10.1016/j.jsp.2021.09.004) is that exact original evaluation of ABC Support. No prior adjudication or state file exists.
